ai.contextLines.hint: How many recent terminal lines may be attached when you send context ({{fallback}} by default, at most {{max}}). More lines means a higher token bill and a bigger chance of leaking sensitive output.
ai.contextLines.label: Terminal context lines
ai.disclosure: AI suggestions are generated by a third-party service you configure yourself: your commands and terminal context leave this machine. Every suggested command still requires your explicit confirmation before it is written to a terminal.
ai.enabledHint: Off by default. While it is on, prompts you send — and, if you enable it in the panel, recent terminal output — go to the third-party provider you configured. Nothing is sent while it is off.
ai.models.hint: Loads the provider's real model list as soon as an API key is filled in — no need to save the provider first.
ai.models.needKey: Fill in an API key before loading models
ai.models.noMatch: No matching model · press Enter to use "{{value}}"
ai.provider.add: Add a provider in Settings → AI
ai.provider.hint: Used for new conversations. You can still switch providers inside the AI panel.
ai.provider.label: Default provider
ai.provider.loadFailed: Could not read the provider list: {{detail}}
ai.provider.locked: Providers live in the encrypted vault, which is currently locked. Unlock it and retry to pick a default provider.
ai.providers.hint: Each provider stores its endpoint and API key in the encrypted vault. The key is written once and never read back — the list only shows its last 4 characters.
ai.providers.keySaved: A key is saved: {{mask}}. Type a new one to replace it.
ai.providers.label: Providers
ai.reasoning.anthropicNote: When the saved max_tokens is too small, this request is temporarily raised to {{tokens}} (config is not written back, and temperature is not sent).
ai.reasoning.highHint: Deeper reasoning, slower and more expensive. Good for troubleshooting.
ai.reasoning.hint: Editable in exactly one place — here. Mapped per provider protocol to each vendor's own reasoning-strength parameter; local and unsupported endpoints ignore it. Switching applies immediately.
ai.reasoning.lowHint: Faster and cheaper. Fine for small fixes and command tweaks.
ai.reasoning.noDefault: No default provider yet: pick one and this level will actually be sent.
ai.reasoning.title: Default reasoning effort
ai.reasoningEffort.anthropicNote: This level needs an output limit of at least {{min}}: the request is raised for that call only — the value you saved stays as is.
ai.reasoningEffort.caption.high: Deeper reasoning, slower and more expensive. Good for troubleshooting.
ai.reasoningEffort.caption.low: Faster and cheaper. Fine for small fixes and command tweaks.
ai.reasoningEffort.hint: Editable in exactly one place. Mapped per provider protocol to each vendor's own reasoning-strength parameter; local and unsupported endpoints ignore it.
ai.reasoningEffort.label: Default reasoning effort
ai.reasoningEffort.noDefault: No default provider yet: pick one and this setting will actually be sent.
ai.reasoningEffort.unsupported: {{provider}} does not support reasoning effort, ignored for now.
appearance.font.familyHint: Monospace font used by the terminal. Pick a preset or type a font installed on this machine (comma-separated fallbacks).
appearance.font.sizeHint: 8–40 px, applied to open terminals immediately. To zoom a single tab temporarily use ⌘/Ctrl + +, and ⌘/Ctrl + 0 to reset.
locale.hint: Switches immediately and is remembered on this device. Day and date formats follow the language.
locale.label: Language
theme.contrast.allGood: All pairs meet the recommended ratio
theme.contrast.bodyWarning: {{pair}} is {{ratio}}:1 — below 4.5:1. Readability may suffer; you can still save.
theme.contrast.title: Contrast check
theme.deleteConfirm: Delete theme "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
theme.exportHint: Copy this JSON to back up the theme or share it with another machine.
theme.importDropHint: or paste it below — nothing is uploaded, the file is read in this window

theme.storage.local: The theme store is not wired up yet, so custom themes are parked in local storage on this device.
theme.storage.unavailable: Custom themes cannot be saved right now: local storage is unavailable.
theme.tokens.covered: Overrides {{covered}} of {{total}} tokens, the rest inherit from {{base}}

themeError.readFailed: Could not read that file. Choose the .json file Termans exported (or paste its text below).
